name: Knowlix generated reference benchmark
provenance: Every case starts from a real record drawn at random from the Crossref REST API `sample` endpoint (journal articles from four date ranges, book chapters, conference papers, books, preprints, datasets, plus samples from publishers whose records are mostly not in English) or from the DataCite REST API `random` listing (arXiv and Zenodo). Records with no title, no author or no year, and non-citable items such as front matter, errata and book reviews, were skipped before any case was run. Real cases print the record in one of six citation styles, BibTeX or as a bare DOI, using hand-written templates. Imperfect cases add one honest slip to a real record. Fake cases mutate a real record: the DOI is re-rolled or two characters are swapped (and doi.org confirmed the result is unregistered), or the title/authors are replaced with invented ones (and Crossref's title search confirmed no close real title), or two real papers are spliced together.

categories.name: Journal article, with DOI
categories.description: Random real journal articles from the 1800s to 2025, written out in six citation styles with the correct DOI.

categories.name: Journal article, no DOI
categories.description: Random real journal articles written out without any DOI, so they must be found by searching.

categories.name: Book chapter
categories.description: Random real book chapters, half with their DOI and half without.

categories.name: Conference paper
categories.description: Random real conference papers, half with their DOI and half without.

categories.name: Book
categories.description: Random real books and monographs, half with their DOI and half without.

categories.name: Preprint (Crossref)
categories.description: Random real preprints registered with Crossref (bioRxiv, Research Square, SSRN and similar).

categories.name: Dataset (Crossref)
categories.description: Random real dataset records registered with Crossref, cited with their DOI.

categories.name: Non-English title
categories.description: Real works whose titles are not in English (Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Japanese…), half with DOI and half without.

categories.name: arXiv and Zenodo (DataCite)
categories.description: Random real arXiv preprints and Zenodo records. Their DOIs are issued by DataCite, not Crossref.

categories.name: Only a DOI
categories.description: A real DOI on its own, or as a doi.org link, with no other details.

categories.name: BibTeX entry
categories.description: Random real works written as BibTeX entries.

categories.name: Year off by one
categories.description: A real work with the year one too high or one too low.

categories.name: Typo in the title
categories.description: A real work with one or two letters swapped in the title.

categories.name: First names spelled out
categories.description: A real work where the student wrote full first names where the style expects initials.

categories.name: Cut to “et al.”
categories.description: A real work with several authors, written as the first author plus “et al.”.

categories.name: Abbreviated journal name
categories.description: A real article with the journal name abbreviated (for example “J. Appl. Phys.”).

categories.name: Volume and pages left out
categories.description: A real article with no volume, issue or page numbers.

categories.name: Title in capitals
categories.description: A real work with the title typed in ALL CAPITALS.

categories.name: Title without capitals
categories.description: A real work with the title typed entirely in lower case.

categories.name: Invented DOI on a real title
categories.description: A real reference, but its DOI is replaced by a made-up one under the same publisher prefix. No registry has that DOI.

categories.name: Real DOI, different paper
categories.description: A real DOI attached to an invented title and invented authors.

categories.name: Fully invented paper
categories.description: Invented title and authors in a real journal, with no DOI. It can never be proven wrong, but it must never be called verified.

categories.name: Real title, wrong authors and year
categories.description: The title of a real paper, credited to invented authors in the wrong year, with no DOI.

categories.name: Chimera of two real papers
categories.description: The real authors, year and journal of one paper combined with the title of another, with no DOI.

categories.name: DOI with two characters swapped
categories.description: A real reference whose DOI has two neighbouring characters swapped, so it no longer points to that paper.

categories.name: Invented book with a fake ISBN
categories.description: An invented book from a real publisher, with an ISBN that passes the checksum but that Open Library has never seen.
